type_descriptions.ANL: You love solving problems, working with data, and thinking deeply before acting.
type_descriptions.LDR: You are natural at guiding people, making decisions, and taking responsibility.
type_descriptions.CRE: You think outside the box, express yourself boldly, and imagine new possibilities.
type_descriptions.HLP: You are driven by purpose, care deeply about people, and want to make a difference.
type_descriptions.TEC: You enjoy building, fixing, and understanding how systems and technology work.
type_descriptions.ENT: You are ambitious, spot opportunities others miss, and love the idea of building something of your own.

questions.question: When you have free time, what do you enjoy most?

options.text: Solving puzzles, riddles, or brain teasers
Organising activities or events for people
Drawing, writing stories, or making things
Helping someone who is struggling

questions.question: In a group project at school, you naturally become...

options.text: The researcher who finds and analyses all the facts
The leader who organises and assigns tasks
The designer who makes the presentation look great
The motivator who keeps the team's spirits up

questions.question: Which of these sounds the most exciting to you?

options.text: Building an app, website, or fixing computers
Starting your own business and being your own boss
Discovering how the human body or nature works
Teaching and mentoring young people in your community

questions.question: When you face a difficult problem, you...

options.text: Break it into smaller parts and analyse each one
Look for a creative solution no one has tried before
Gather people together and lead the discussion
Think about who the solution will help the most
Working with computers, machines, or technology daily
Leading a big team or running an organisation
Creating art, music, films, or digital designs
Building a business from nothing and growing it

questions.question: Your friends would most likely describe you as...

options.text: Smart, logical, and always thinking
